report.visual_transcript: Host inspected the fresh initial rear-quarter and rotated front-quarter source screenshots for fin-slim10-inverse-transpose. Relative to the original S7, broad staircase-like white fin slabs at the upper rear intake are replaced by narrow divider edges; lower broad white tooth projections are reduced to fine short gray endpoints. The car shell, wheels, doors and skirts remain seated. Two upper divider edges per side and fine lower lines remain in the ownership-color comparisons; exact ten-group retention is established by native geometry checks, not visibility alone. Small finite endpoints remain and strict source intersections are not proven absent. The no-fin slot-color, body-removal and fender-removal controls retain the upper cavity background. The no-fin skirt primitive-color control renders portions of that background red (main CarPaintCustomizable geometry) and blue (blackmatte geometry), within the same skirts resource. Removing blackmatte reveals narrow dark gaps behind the main-paint cavity sides. These controls support source ownership as native skirt cavity surfaces, not a newly displaced separate attachment. The gray shade is not proof of intended game color or material fidelity.
limits: Explicit preview thinning changes native fin shape and shading; no game equivalence claim.
Residual finite endpoints and native intersections remain; no all-angle or zero-contact certification.
Geometry invariants and exact counts do not by themselves prove visual quality.

claims: In the supplied host transcript, the slim10 inverse-transpose S7 candidate reduces the original broad white fin protrusions to narrower divider edges in two source-viewer views, while small finite endpoints remain.

The independently checked candidate preserves the original triangle indices and counts, main-shell geometry and normals, UVs, tangents and colors, and native coordinate weld consistency, while deliberately thinning all ten fins.

The supplied ownership controls support locating the remaining upper cavity background in the same native skirts resource's main-paint and blackmatte geometry, rather than a separately misplaced door, body or fender attachment.
